description: Sets the level one care program runs at on one site (get_care_status lists the levels the owner may choose). Only owners and admins can. A program with a lowest level (security) cannot go below it: the answer names that level. The change is kept with the person's reason in the site's care history.

level.description: One of the levels get_care_status lists for the program.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the site's care history.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: set_care_preferences
title: Change a care level
